fr.R: Ensuite, Saül a donné des ordres à ses officiers. Il leur a dit : « Parlez à David quand personne d’autre n’est là. Dites-lui : “Le roi t’aime bien, et tous ses officiers t’aiment. Tu devrais épouser la fille du roi maintenant.” »

sw.L: Sauli akawaamuru watumishi wake, "Semeni na Daudi kwa siri, mkisema, 'Tazama, mfalme amependezwa nawe, na watumishi wake wote wanakupenda; basi sasa uwe mkwe wa mfalme.'"
sw.B: Kisha Sauli akawaagiza maafisa wake, "Zungumzeni na Daudi faraghani, mkamwambie, 'Mfalme amependezwa nawe, na maafisa wake wote wanakupenda. Sasa ndio wakati wa kuwa mkwe wa mfalme.'"
sw.R: Kisha Sauli akawapa maafisa wake maagizo. Akasema, "Zungumzeni na Daudi wakati hakuna mtu mwingine. Mwambieni, 'Mfalme anakupenda, na maafisa wake wote wanakupenda. Sasa umwoe binti ya mfalme.'"

vi.L: Sau-lơ ra lệnh cho các đầy tớ mình: "Hãy nói riêng với Đa-vít rằng: 'Kìa, vua thích ông, và tất cả các đầy tớ của vua đều yêu mến ông; vậy bây giờ ông hãy làm con rể của vua.'"
vi.B: Rồi Sau-lơ ra lệnh cho các quần thần: "Hãy nói riêng với Đa-vít rằng: 'Vua rất quý ông, và tất cả quần thần đều yêu mến ông. Bây giờ là lúc ông nên làm con rể của vua.'"
vi.R: Rồi Sau-lơ ra lệnh cho các quần thần. Vua nói: "Hãy nói chuyện với Đa-vít khi không có ai khác ở đó. Hãy bảo nó: 'Vua thích ông, và tất cả quần thần đều yêu mến ông. Ông nên cưới con gái vua ngay đi.'"

decisions.choice: in secret: privately, as if on their own
decisions.reason: The officials are to speak as though giving friendly advice, without saying that the king sent them.

decisions.choice: delights in you ... love you: the king and his court favor you
decisions.reason: "Delight in" means to be pleased with and to want (verse 25 uses the same word for what the king "wants"). "Love" is loyalty and good will, as in verse 16.

decisions.choice: be son-in-law to the king: marry into the king's family
decisions.reason: The verb is formed from the word for a son-in-law or bridegroom and means to become related by marriage. It is repeated through verses 21-27.

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, the king's servants are court officials.

decisions.choice: marry the king's daughter
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what becoming the king's son-in-law means.

source.text: וַֽיְדַבְּר֞וּ עַבְדֵ֤י שָׁאוּל֙ בְּאָזְנֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗ד הַֽנְקַלָּ֤ה בְעֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הִתְחַתֵּ֣ן בַּמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְאָנֹכִ֖י אִֽישׁ־רָ֥שׁ וְנִקְלֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke [the] servants of Saul in [the] ears of David the words the these. And said David, [Is it] light in your eyes to be son-in-law to the king, and I [am] a man poor and lightly esteemed?

en.L: And Saul's servants spoke these words in the ears of David. And David said, "Is it a light thing in your eyes to become son-in-law to the king, when I [am] a poor man and lightly esteemed?"
en.B: Saul's officials spoke these words to David. But David said, "Do you think it is a small thing to become the king's son-in-law? I am only a poor man of no importance."
en.R: Saul's officials told David what Saul had said. But David answered, "Becoming the king's son-in-law is a big thing. I am a poor man, and people do not think I am important."

es.L: Y hablaron los siervos de Saúl estas palabras a los oídos de David. Y dijo David: «¿{{plural_you:Les parece poca cosa a sus ojos|Os parece poca cosa a vuestros ojos}} ser yerno del rey, siendo yo un hombre pobre y de poca estima?».
es.B: Los oficiales de Saúl le dijeron estas palabras a David. Pero David respondió: «¿{{plural_you:Creen|Creéis}} que es poca cosa llegar a ser yerno del rey? Yo no soy más que un hombre pobre y sin importancia».
es.R: Los oficiales de Saúl le contaron a David lo que Saúl había dicho. Pero David contestó: «Llegar a ser yerno del rey es algo muy grande. Yo soy un hombre pobre, y la gente no me tiene por importante».

fr.L: Et les serviteurs de Saül dirent ces paroles aux oreilles de David. Et David dit : « Est-ce peu de chose à vos yeux de devenir le gendre du roi, alors que moi, [je suis] un homme pauvre et peu considéré ? »
fr.B: Les officiers de Saül répétèrent ces paroles à David. Mais David répondit : « Pensez-vous que ce soit peu de chose de devenir le gendre du roi ? Je ne suis qu’un homme pauvre et sans importance. »
fr.R: Les officiers de Saül ont répété à David ce que Saül avait dit. Mais David a répondu : « Devenir le gendre du roi, c’est quelque chose de grand. Moi, je suis un homme pauvre, et les gens ne me trouvent pas important. »

sw.L: Watumishi wa Sauli wakasema maneno haya masikioni mwa Daudi. Daudi akasema, "Je, ni jambo dogo machoni penu kuwa mkwe wa mfalme, nami ni mtu maskini na mdogo wa heshima?"
sw.B: Maafisa wa Sauli wakamwambia Daudi maneno hayo. Lakini Daudi akasema, "Mnadhani ni jambo dogo kuwa mkwe wa mfalme? Mimi ni mtu maskini tu, nisiye na cheo."
sw.R: Maafisa wa Sauli wakamwambia Daudi yale Sauli aliyosema. Lakini Daudi akajibu, "Kuwa mkwe wa mfalme ni jambo kubwa. Mimi ni maskini, na watu hawanioni kuwa mtu muhimu."

vi.L: Các đầy tớ của Sau-lơ nói những lời này vào tai Đa-vít. Đa-vít nói: "Làm con rể của vua là chuyện nhẹ trong mắt các ông sao, khi tôi [là] một người nghèo hèn và bị coi nhẹ?"
vi.B: Các quần thần của Sau-lơ nói những lời ấy với Đa-vít. Nhưng Đa-vít đáp: "Các ông nghĩ làm con rể của vua là chuyện nhỏ sao? Tôi chỉ là một người nghèo, chẳng có danh giá gì."
vi.R: Các quần thần của Sau-lơ nói với Đa-vít những gì vua đã dặn. Nhưng Đa-vít đáp: "Làm con rể vua là chuyện lớn lắm. Tôi là người nghèo, và người ta không coi tôi là quan trọng."

decisions.choice: a light thing ... lightly esteemed: a play on one word
decisions.reason: Both words come from the same root, meaning "light" or "of little weight". David asks if they think marrying into the king's family is a light matter, when he himself is a man of light standing.

decisions.choice: a poor man: he cannot pay a bride-price fit for a king's daughter
decisions.reason: A man who married gave a bride-price to the bride's family (Genesis 34:12; Exodus 22:15-16). David's answer is humble, and it also says that he cannot afford a king's daughter. Saul answers this point in verse 25.

decisions.choice: spoke in the ears of David: told David
decisions.reason: To speak "in someone's ears" means to speak to that person directly.

decisions.choice: a statement instead of a question
decisions.reason: Readable turns David's question into the statement it implies.

decisions.choice: peu de chose ... peu considéré
decisions.reason: The two Hebrew words share one root, "light" (m1); Literal echoes it with "peu" twice, which French can carry where "léger" would not fit both.

decisions.choice: poca cosa ... de poca estima
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on one word, “light” (m1); Literal keeps the echo with “poca”, which the other levels let go, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "jambo dogo ... mdogo wa heshima"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on one root, "light" (m1); Literal echoes it with "dogo" and "mdogo".

source.text: וַיַּגִּ֜דוּ עַבְדֵ֥י שָׁא֛וּל ל֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר כַּדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה דִּבֶּ֥ר דָּוִֽד׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And told [the] servants of Saul to him, saying, According to the words the these spoke David.

en.L: And Saul's servants told him, saying, "David spoke according to these words."
en.B: Saul's officials told him, "This is what David said."
en.R: Saul's officials went back to Saul and told him what David had said.

es.L: Y le informaron a Saúl sus siervos, diciendo: «Conforme a estas palabras habló David».
es.B: Los oficiales de Saúl le informaron: «Esto es lo que dijo David».
es.R: Los oficiales de Saúl volvieron y le contaron lo que David había dicho.

fr.L: Et les serviteurs de Saül le lui rapportèrent, en disant : « David a parlé selon ces paroles. »
fr.B: Les officiers de Saül lui rapportèrent : « Voilà ce que David a dit. »
fr.R: Les officiers de Saül sont retournés voir Saül et ils lui ont raconté ce que David avait dit.

sw.L: Watumishi wa Sauli wakamwambia, wakisema, "Daudi amesema sawasawa na maneno haya."
sw.B: Maafisa wa Sauli wakamwambia, "Hivi ndivyo Daudi alivyosema."
sw.R: Maafisa wa Sauli wakarudi kwa Sauli, wakamweleza yale Daudi aliyosema.

vi.L: Các đầy tớ của Sau-lơ thuật lại cho ông rằng: "Đa-vít đã nói những lời như thế."
vi.B: Các quần thần thưa lại với Sau-lơ: "Đa-vít đã nói như thế."
vi.R: Các quần thần trở về kể lại với Sau-lơ những gì Đa-vít đã nói.

decisions.choice: according to these words David spoke: they report David's answer
decisions.reason: The officials repeat what David said in verse 23, his humility and his poverty.

decisions.choice: told him what David had said
decisions.reason: Readable gives the report as indirect speech.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל כֹּֽה־תֹאמְר֣וּ לְדָוִ֗ד אֵֽין־חֵ֤פֶץ לַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ בְּמֹ֔הַר כִּ֗י בְּמֵאָה֙ עָרְל֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְהִנָּקֵ֖ם בְּאֹיְבֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְשָׁא֣וּל חָשַׁ֔ב לְהַפִּ֥יל אֶת־דָּוִ֖ד בְּיַד־פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Saul, Thus you will say to David: There is no delight for the king in bride-price, except in a hundred foreskins of Philistines, to take vengeance on [the] enemies of the king. And Saul planned to make fall David by [the] hand of [the] Philistines.

en.L: And Saul said, "Thus you shall say to David: 'The king has no delight in a bride-price except a hundred foreskins of Philistines, to take vengeance on the king's enemies.'" And Saul planned to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.
en.B: Saul replied, "Say this to David: 'The king wants no bride-price except a hundred Philistine foreskins, to take revenge on the king's enemies.'" Saul was planning to have David killed by the Philistines.
en.R: Saul said, "Tell David this: 'The king does not want any money or gifts for his daughter. He wants only the foreskins of one hundred Philistines. That will pay back the king's enemies.'" Saul was really planning to have the Philistines kill David.

es.L: Y dijo Saúl: «Así {{plural_you:dirán|diréis}} a David: “El rey no desea dote alguna, sino cien prepucios de filisteos, para vengarse de los enemigos del rey”». Y Saúl pensaba hacer caer a David por mano de los filisteos.
es.B: Saúl respondió: «{{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}} esto a David: “El rey no quiere más dote que cien prepucios de filisteos, para vengarse de los enemigos del rey”». Saúl planeaba hacer que los filisteos mataran a David.
es.R: Saúl dijo: «{{plural_you:Díganle|Decidle}} esto a David: “El rey no quiere dinero ni regalos por su hija. Solo quiere los prepucios de cien filisteos. Así se vengará de los enemigos del rey”». En realidad, Saúl estaba planeando que los filisteos mataran a David.

fr.L: Et Saül dit : « Vous direz ainsi à David : “Le roi ne désire pas de dot, sinon cent prépuces de Philistins, pour se venger des ennemis du roi.” » Et Saül pensait faire tomber David par la main des Philistins.
fr.B: Saül répondit : « Dites ceci à David : “Le roi ne veut pas d’autre dot que cent prépuces de Philistins, pour se venger des ennemis du roi.” » Saül comptait faire tuer David par les Philistins.
fr.R: Saül a dit : « Dites ceci à David : “Le roi ne veut ni argent ni cadeaux pour sa fille. Il veut seulement les prépuces de cent Philistins. Ainsi, le roi se vengera de ses ennemis.” » En réalité, Saül voulait que les Philistins tuent David.

sw.L: Sauli akasema, "Hivi ndivyo mtakavyomwambia Daudi: 'Mfalme hapendezwi na mahari yoyote ila magovi mia moja ya Wafilisti, ili kujilipizia kisasi juu ya adui za mfalme.'" Sauli akapanga kumwangusha Daudi kwa mkono wa Wafilisti.
sw.B: Sauli akajibu, "Mwambieni Daudi hivi: 'Mfalme hataki mahari yoyote ila magovi mia moja ya Wafilisti, ili kulipiza kisasi kwa adui za mfalme.'" Sauli alikuwa akipanga Daudi auawe na Wafilisti.
sw.R: Sauli akasema, "Mwambieni Daudi hivi: 'Mfalme hataki mahari ya fedha wala zawadi kwa ajili ya binti yake. Anataka tu magovi ya Wafilisti mia moja. Hayo yatakuwa kisasi juu ya adui za mfalme.'" Kwa kweli Sauli alikuwa akipanga Wafilisti wamwue Daudi.

vi.L: Sau-lơ nói: "Các ngươi hãy nói với Đa-vít như vầy: 'Vua không muốn sính lễ nào, ngoại trừ một trăm dương bì của người Phi-li-tin, để báo thù các kẻ thù của vua.'" Sau-lơ tính kế để Đa-vít ngã dưới tay người Phi-li-tin.
vi.B: Sau-lơ đáp: "Hãy nói với Đa-vít như vầy: 'Vua không đòi sính lễ nào ngoài một trăm dương bì của người Phi-li-tin, để báo thù kẻ thù của vua.'" Sau-lơ đang tính kế để Đa-vít bị người Phi-li-tin giết.
vi.R: Sau-lơ nói: "Hãy bảo Đa-vít thế này: 'Vua không cần tiền bạc hay quà cáp gì để cưới con gái vua. Vua chỉ cần dương bì của một trăm người Phi-li-tin. Như vậy là báo thù được kẻ thù của vua.'" Thật ra Sau-lơ đang tính kế để người Phi-li-tin giết Đa-vít.

decisions.choice: a bride-price: the payment a man gave to his bride's family
decisions.reason: A bride-price was given to the bride's father when a marriage was agreed (Genesis 34:12; Exodus 22:15-16). It could also be paid in service or a great deed (Genesis 29:18; Joshua 15:16). Saul answers David's poverty (verse 23) by asking for a deed instead of wealth.

decisions.choice: a hundred foreskins of Philistines: proof of a hundred Philistines killed
decisions.reason: The foreskin is the fold of skin removed in circumcision. Israel was circumcised and the Philistines were not; "uncircumcised" was a common name for them (14:6; 17:26, 36). Bringing back their foreskins proved how many enemies had been killed, and that they were Philistines.

decisions.choice: to take vengeance on the king's enemies: Saul presents the price as a public duty
decisions.reason: Saul calls the Philistines "the king's enemies", but the narrator tells the real aim at once: to have David killed in the attempt (compare verse 17).

decisions.choice: to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines: to have him killed by them
decisions.reason: "Fall" means fall dead in battle; "by the hand of" means by their power or action.

decisions.choice: any money or gifts for his daughter
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a bride-price is instead of using the term.

decisions.choice: foreskins
decisions.reason: The word is kept at every level. It is plain, not crude, and the point of the story depends on it.

decisions.choice: la dot
decisions.reason: French "dot" normally names what a bride brings, but it is also the word used for the marriage gift a groom pays in the Bible's world, and it is the shortest clear term; Readable explains it, as the English (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: dote
decisions.reason: The payment a man gave to his bride's family (m1). Spanish “dote” is the usual word for it in Bible translation, though in modern use it can mean the bride's own goods; Readable spells it out as money or gifts for his daughter, as the English does (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "mahari"; "magovi"
decisions.reason: "Mahari" is the Swahili word for the bride-price given to the bride's family, the custom the Hebrew names (m1), so every level keeps it; Readable adds what it was made of. "Govi" (foreskin) is the plain word, kept at every level as the English keeps it.

decisions.choice: "dương bì" (foreskin) at every level
decisions.reason: The usual Vietnamese Bible word, plain but not crude; the meaning decision (m2) says why the price was asked.

decisions.choice: "sính lễ" for the bride-price
decisions.reason: "của hồi môn" is the dowry a bride brings; "sính lễ" is what the groom's side gives her family, as the bride-price was (m1).

source.text: וַיַּגִּ֨דוּ עֲבָדָ֤יו לְדָוִד֙ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיִּשַׁ֤ר הַדָּבָר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד לְהִתְחַתֵּ֖ן בַּמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְלֹ֥א מָלְא֖וּ הַיָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And told his servants to David the words the these, and was right the thing in [the] eyes of David to be son-in-law to the king; and not were fulfilled the days.

en.L: And his servants told David these words, and the thing was right in David's eyes, to become son-in-law to the king. And the days were not [yet] fulfilled,
en.B: When his officials told David these words, David was pleased with the idea of becoming the king's son-in-law. Before the time was up,
en.R: Saul's officials told David what Saul wanted, and David was glad to become the king's son-in-law. Before the time Saul had set was over,

es.L: Y sus siervos contaron a David estas palabras, y la cosa le pareció bien a los ojos de David, ser yerno del rey. Y no se habían cumplido los días,
es.B: Cuando sus oficiales le contaron estas palabras a David, a él le agradó la idea de ser yerno del rey. Antes de que se cumpliera el plazo,
es.R: Los oficiales de Saúl le contaron a David lo que Saúl quería, y David se alegró de llegar a ser yerno del rey. Antes de que terminara el plazo que Saúl había puesto,

fr.L: Et ses serviteurs rapportèrent ces paroles à David, et la chose fut droite aux yeux de David, de devenir le gendre du roi. Et les jours n’étaient pas [encore] accomplis,
fr.B: Quand ses officiers rapportèrent ces paroles à David, il fut content de devenir le gendre du roi. Avant que le délai soit écoulé,
fr.R: Les officiers de Saül ont dit à David ce que Saül voulait, et David a été content de devenir le gendre du roi. Avant la fin du temps que Saül avait fixé,

sw.L: Watumishi wake wakamwambia Daudi maneno haya, na jambo hilo likawa jema machoni pa Daudi, kuwa mkwe wa mfalme. Na siku zilikuwa hazijatimia,
sw.B: Maafisa wake walipomwambia Daudi maneno hayo, Daudi akapendezwa na wazo la kuwa mkwe wa mfalme. Kabla muda haujaisha,
sw.R: Maafisa wa Sauli wakamwambia Daudi yale Sauli aliyotaka, naye Daudi akafurahi kuwa mkwe wa mfalme. Kabla muda aliouweka Sauli haujaisha,

vi.L: Các đầy tớ của ông kể lại cho Đa-vít những lời này, và việc làm con rể vua là đúng trong mắt Đa-vít. Những ngày [hạn định] chưa mãn,
vi.B: Khi các quần thần thuật lại những lời ấy cho Đa-vít, Đa-vít vui lòng làm con rể của vua. Trước khi hết hạn,
vi.R: Các quần thần của Sau-lơ nói cho Đa-vít biết điều vua muốn, và Đa-vít vui mừng được làm con rể vua. Trước khi hết thời hạn Sau-lơ đã định,

decisions.choice: the days were not yet fulfilled: the time set for the deed had not run out
alternatives: and the days had not yet been completed when ...
decisions.reason: The narrator had not mentioned a deadline, but this shows that one was set. The clause begins the action of verse 27: David acted quickly. The main early Greek manuscript does not have it (see the note at verse 1).

decisions.choice: the thing was right in David's eyes: David was pleased
decisions.reason: The same words were used of Saul in verse 20. Each man is pleased for his own reason.

decisions.choice: his officials (Balanced); Saul's officials (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 22. Readable names Saul to avoid confusion over whose officials they were.

decisions.choice: the time Saul had set
decisions.reason: Readable says that the days were a time limit Saul had given.

source.text: וַיָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֜ד וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ׀ה֣וּא וַאֲנָשָׁ֗יו וַיַּ֣ךְ בַּפְּלִשְׁתִּים֮ מָאתַ֣יִם אִישׁ֒ וַיָּבֵ֤א דָוִד֙ אֶת־עָרְלֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וַיְמַלְא֣וּם לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְהִתְחַתֵּ֖ן בַּמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּתֶּן־ל֥וֹ שָׁא֛וּל אֶת־מִיכַ֥ל בִּתּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And arose David and went, he and his men, and struck down among the Philistines two hundred men, and brought David their foreskins, and they gave them in full to the king, to become son-in-law to the king; and gave to him Saul Michal his daughter as wife.

en.L: David arose and went, he and his men, and struck down two hundred men among the Philistines. And David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full to the king, so as to become son-in-law to the king. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter as a wife.
en.B: David got up and went out with his men and killed two hundred Philistine men. He brought their foreskins, and they were counted out in full to the king, so that David could become the king's son-in-law. Then Saul gave him his daughter Michal as his wife.
en.R: David went out with his men and killed two hundred Philistines. David brought their foreskins to the king and counted them out to show that the full number was there. He did this so that he could become the king's son-in-law. So Saul let David marry his daughter Michal.

es.L: se levantó David y fue, él y sus hombres, y mató entre los filisteos a doscientos hombres. Y trajo David sus prepucios, y los entregaron completos al rey, para ser yerno del rey. Y le dio Saúl a Mical su hija por esposa.
es.B: David se levantó y salió con sus hombres, y mató a doscientos filisteos. Trajo sus prepucios, y se los contaron completos al rey, para que David pudiera ser yerno del rey. Entonces Saúl le dio por esposa a su hija Mical.
es.R: David salió con sus hombres y mató a doscientos filisteos. Le llevó al rey los prepucios y los contó delante de él, para mostrar que estaba el número completo. Lo hizo para poder ser yerno del rey. Así que Saúl dejó que David se casara con su hija Mical.

fr.L: David se leva et partit, lui et ses hommes, et il frappa parmi les Philistins deux cents hommes. Et David apporta leurs prépuces, et on les livra au complet au roi, pour devenir le gendre du roi. Et Saül lui donna pour femme Mikal, sa fille.
fr.B: David se leva et partit avec ses hommes, et il tua deux cents Philistins. Il rapporta leurs prépuces, et on les compta au complet devant le roi, pour que David puisse devenir le gendre du roi. Alors Saül lui donna sa fille Mikal pour femme.
fr.R: David est parti avec ses hommes et il a tué deux cents Philistins. Il a apporté leurs prépuces au roi et il les a comptés devant lui pour montrer qu’il y en avait assez. Il a fait cela pour pouvoir devenir le gendre du roi. Alors Saül a laissé David épouser sa fille Mikal.

sw.L: Daudi akainuka, akaenda, yeye na watu wake, akawapiga watu mia mbili miongoni mwa Wafilisti. Daudi akaleta magovi yao, wakayatoa yote kamili kwa mfalme, ili awe mkwe wa mfalme. Sauli akampa Mikali binti yake kuwa mke wake.
sw.B: Daudi akaondoka, akatoka pamoja na watu wake, akawaua Wafilisti mia mbili. Akaleta magovi yao, nayo yakahesabiwa yote kamili mbele ya mfalme, ili Daudi apate kuwa mkwe wa mfalme. Ndipo Sauli akampa binti yake Mikali kuwa mke wake.
sw.R: Daudi akatoka pamoja na watu wake, akawaua Wafilisti mia mbili. Daudi akamletea mfalme magovi yao, akayahesabu mbele yake kuonyesha kwamba idadi ilikuwa kamili. Alifanya hivyo ili awe mkwe wa mfalme. Basi Sauli akamruhusu Daudi amwoe binti yake Mikali.

vi.L: Đa-vít đứng dậy và đi, ông và những người của ông, giết hai trăm người trong số người Phi-li-tin. Đa-vít đem dương bì của họ về, và họ nộp đủ số cho vua, để được làm con rể của vua. Sau-lơ gả con gái mình là Mi-canh cho ông làm vợ.
vi.B: Đa-vít đứng dậy cùng thuộc hạ ra đi và giết hai trăm người Phi-li-tin. Ông đem dương bì của họ về và nộp đủ số cho vua, để được làm con rể của vua. Bấy giờ Sau-lơ gả con gái mình là Mi-canh cho ông làm vợ.
vi.R: Đa-vít cùng thuộc hạ ra đi và giết hai trăm người Phi-li-tin. Đa-vít đem dương bì của họ về cho vua và đếm ra để cho thấy là đủ số. Ông làm vậy để được làm con rể của vua. Vậy Sau-lơ cho Đa-vít cưới con gái mình là Mi-canh.

decisions.choice: two hundred men
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "two hundred". The early Greek translation has "a hundred", the number Saul asked for, and David later speaks of the hundred foreskins he paid for Michal (2 Samuel 3:14). In the Hebrew, David gives twice the price asked.

decisions.choice: they gave them in full: the foreskins were counted out before the king
decisions.reason: The verb means to fill or complete: the full number was handed over. The plural "they" may be David and his men, or it may simply mean that the count was made.

decisions.choice: Saul gave him Michal: Saul's trap fails
decisions.reason: Saul had hoped David would die (verse 25). Instead David comes back alive, and Saul has to keep his word. Verse 28 tells why: Yahweh was with David.

decisions.choice: so that David could become (Balanced); He did this so that (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the purpose clear and name David.

source.text: וַיַּ֤רְא שָׁאוּל֙ וַיֵּ֔דַע כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִם־דָּוִ֑ד וּמִיכַ֥ל בַּת־שָׁא֖וּל אֲהֵבַֽתְהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw Saul and knew that Yahweh [was] with David, and Michal daughter of Saul loved him.

en.L: And Saul saw and knew that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [was] with David, and that Michal, Saul's daughter, loved him.
en.B: Saul saw and understood that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was with David, and that his own daughter Michal loved him.
en.R: Saul now understood that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was with David. He also knew that his daughter Michal loved David.

es.L: Y vio Saúl y supo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [estaba] con David, y que Mical, hija de Saúl, lo amaba.
es.B: Saúl vio y comprendió que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba con David, y que su propia hija Mical lo amaba.
es.R: Ahora Saúl comprendió que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estaba con David. También sabía que su hija Mical amaba a David.

fr.L: Et Saül vit et sut que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [était] avec David, et que Mikal, fille de Saül, l’aimait.
fr.B: Saül vit et comprit que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était avec David, et que sa propre fille Mikal l’aimait.
fr.R: Maintenant, Saül comprenait que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} était avec David. Il savait aussi que sa fille Mikal aimait David.

sw.L: Sauli akaona na kujua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [alikuwa] pamoja na Daudi, na kwamba Mikali binti ya Sauli alimpenda.
sw.B: Sauli akaona na kuelewa kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa pamoja na Daudi, na kwamba binti yake mwenyewe Mikali alimpenda.
sw.R: Sasa Sauli akaelewa kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa pamoja na Daudi. Alijua pia kwamba binti yake Mikali alimpenda Daudi.

vi.L: Sau-lơ thấy và biết rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] với Đa-vít, và Mi-canh, con gái Sau-lơ, yêu ông.
vi.B: Sau-lơ thấy và hiểu rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với Đa-vít, và chính con gái mình là Mi-canh cũng yêu ông.
vi.R: Bây giờ Sau-lơ hiểu rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với Đa-vít. Vua cũng biết con gái mình là Mi-canh yêu Đa-vít.

decisions.choice: Yahweh was with David
decisions.reason: What the narrator said in verses 12 and 14 Saul now sees for himself.

decisions.choice: Michal, Saul's daughter, loved him
decisions.reason: The early Greek translation reads "and all Israel loved him" (compare verse 16). The Hebrew text, followed here, repeats Michal's love from verse 20: even Saul's own daughter is on David's side.

decisions.choice: his own daughter Michal (Balanced); his daughter Michal (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "his daughter" for "daughter of Saul", since Saul is the subject. Balanced adds "own" to keep the weight of naming Saul in the Hebrew.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אסֶף שָׁא֗וּל לֵרֹ֛א מִפְּנֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד ע֑וֹד וַיְהִ֥י שָׁא֛וּל אֹיֵ֥ב אֶת־דָּוִ֖ד כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And added Saul to be afraid from before David still, and was Saul enemy of David all the days.

en.L: And Saul was still more afraid of David, and Saul was an enemy of David all the days.
en.B: Saul became even more afraid of David, and Saul was David's enemy for the rest of his life.
en.R: Saul became even more afraid of David. For the rest of his life, Saul was David's enemy.

es.L: Y Saúl temió aún más a David, y fue Saúl enemigo de David todos los días.
es.B: Saúl le tuvo aún más miedo a David, y fue enemigo de David el resto de su vida.
es.R: Saúl le tuvo todavía más miedo a David. Por el resto de su vida, Saúl fue enemigo de David.

fr.L: Et Saül eut encore plus peur de David, et Saül fut l’ennemi de David tous les jours.
fr.B: Saül eut encore plus peur de David, et il resta l’ennemi de David pour le reste de sa vie.
fr.R: Saül a eu encore plus peur de David. Pendant tout le reste de sa vie, Saül a été l’ennemi de David.

sw.L: Sauli akazidi kumwogopa Daudi, naye Sauli akawa adui wa Daudi siku zote.
sw.B: Sauli akazidi kumwogopa Daudi, naye Sauli akawa adui wa Daudi maisha yake yote yaliyobaki.
sw.R: Sauli akazidi kumwogopa Daudi. Kwa maisha yake yote yaliyobaki, Sauli alikuwa adui wa Daudi.

vi.L: Sau-lơ càng sợ Đa-vít hơn nữa, và Sau-lơ làm kẻ thù của Đa-vít mọi ngày.
vi.B: Sau-lơ càng sợ Đa-vít hơn nữa, và Sau-lơ trở thành kẻ thù của Đa-vít suốt đời.
vi.R: Sau-lơ càng sợ Đa-vít hơn. Suốt quãng đời còn lại, Sau-lơ là kẻ thù của Đa-vít.

decisions.choice: added to be afraid still: became even more afraid
decisions.reason: "Added" with another verb means to do something more or again. Saul's fear grows from verse 12 to verse 15 and now here.

decisions.choice: all the days: from then on, for the rest of his life
decisions.reason: "All the days" means always, here for as long as Saul lived (compare 31:4-6). The main early Greek manuscript does not have this sentence or verse 30 (see the note at verse 1).

decisions.choice: for the rest of his life
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "all the days" means here.

source.text: וַיֵּצְא֖וּ שָׂרֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיְהִ֣י׀מִדֵּ֣י צֵאתָ֗ם שָׂכַ֤ל דָּוִד֙ מִכֹּל֙ עַבְדֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל וַיִּיקַ֥ר שְׁמ֖וֹ מְאֹֽד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And went out [the] commanders of [the] Philistines, and it was, as often as they went out, succeeded David more than all [the] servants of Saul, and was esteemed his name greatly.

en.L: And the commanders of the Philistines went out; and it happened, as often as they went out, David succeeded more than all Saul's servants, and his name was highly esteemed.
en.B: The commanders of the Philistines kept coming out to fight, and every time they came out, David was more successful than all Saul's other officers. So his name became highly honored.
en.R: The Philistine commanders kept leading their armies out to fight Israel. Every time they did, David had more success than any of Saul's other officers. Everyone thought very highly of David.

es.L: Y salían los jefes de los filisteos; y sucedía que, cada vez que salían, David tenía más éxito que todos los siervos de Saúl, y su nombre fue muy estimado.
es.B: Los jefes de los filisteos salían una y otra vez a pelear, y cada vez que salían, David tenía más éxito que todos los demás oficiales de Saúl. Así su nombre llegó a ser muy honrado.
es.R: Los jefes filisteos seguían saliendo con sus ejércitos a pelear contra Israel. Cada vez que lo hacían, David tenía más éxito que cualquiera de los demás oficiales de Saúl. Todos tenían a David en muy alta estima.

fr.L: Et les chefs des Philistins sortirent ; et il arrivait, chaque fois qu’ils sortaient, que David réussissait plus que tous les serviteurs de Saül, et son nom fut très estimé.
fr.B: Les chefs des Philistins sortaient sans cesse pour combattre, et chaque fois qu’ils sortaient, David avait plus de succès que tous les autres officiers de Saül. Son nom devint très célèbre.
fr.R: Les chefs philistins sortaient souvent avec leurs armées pour attaquer Israël. Chaque fois, David réussissait mieux que tous les autres officiers de Saül. Tout le monde avait une très grande estime pour David.

sw.L: Wakuu wa Wafilisti wakatoka; ikawa kila mara walipotoka, Daudi alifanikiwa kuliko watumishi wote wa Sauli, na jina lake likaheshimiwa sana.
sw.B: Majemadari wa Wafilisti waliendelea kutoka kupigana, na kila mara walipotoka, Daudi alifanikiwa kuliko maafisa wengine wote wa Sauli. Hivyo jina lake likaheshimiwa sana.
sw.R: Majemadari wa Wafilisti waliendelea kuongoza majeshi yao kutoka kupigana na Israeli. Kila mara walipofanya hivyo, Daudi alifanikiwa kuliko maafisa wengine wote wa Sauli. Kila mtu akamheshimu Daudi sana.

vi.L: Các thủ lĩnh của người Phi-li-tin kéo ra; và mỗi lần họ kéo ra, Đa-vít thành công hơn tất cả các đầy tớ của Sau-lơ, và danh ông rất được quý trọng.
vi.B: Các thủ lĩnh Phi-li-tin cứ kéo quân ra đánh, và mỗi lần như vậy, Đa-vít đều thành công hơn tất cả các tướng khác của Sau-lơ. Vì thế danh ông rất được tôn trọng.
vi.R: Các thủ lĩnh Phi-li-tin cứ dẫn quân ra đánh Y-sơ-ra-ên. Mỗi lần như vậy, Đa-vít đều thắng nhiều hơn bất cứ tướng nào khác của Sau-lơ. Ai cũng rất quý trọng Đa-vít.

decisions.choice: the commanders of the Philistines: the Philistine war leaders
decisions.reason: The word can name rulers or army officers; here they lead the Philistines out to battle (29:3-4). They will remember David's success (21:12; 29:5).

decisions.choice: succeeded: acted wisely and did well
decisions.reason: The key verb of the chapter (verses 5, 14 and 15).

decisions.choice: his name was highly esteemed: he gained a great reputation
decisions.reason: A "name" is a person's reputation. "Esteemed" means precious or highly valued (compare 26:21).

decisions.choice: Saul's other officers
decisions.reason: In battle the king's servants are his officers. Balanced and Readable say "officers" and add "other", since David is one of them; Literal keeps "servants".

decisions.choice: Everyone thought very highly of David
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom of the name.

decisions.choice: "wakuu wa Wafilisti" (L); "majemadari wa Wafilisti" (B, R)
decisions.reason: These are war leaders (m1), not the "lords of the Philistines" of the terms note (also "wakuu" at Literal); Balanced and Readable name them as army commanders.
